title: Central Ostrobothnia: 0.6 more lung cancer patients a year treated to cure, for €27,200 a year
markdown:
# Central Ostrobothnia: 0.6 more lung cancer patients a year treated to cure, for €27,200 a year

> Closes 0.6 of 1.4 missing patients a year (40%) · €27,200 of €1.00M · €972,800 left: nothing else pays off at these assumptions

## The gap

Of 100 lung cancer patients in Central Ostrobothnia, 22 get treatment that aims to cure. In Finland it is 27. The difference is within what chance alone gives a county of this size. [^care_curative] Compared with the best quarter of counties, 2.4 patients a year are missing from treatment that aims to cure (range 0.1–4.3). [^care_curative][^model] Compared with Finland as a whole, 1.4 a year are missing: 0.0 fewer operated and 1.4 fewer given radiotherapy that aims to cure. [^care_curative][^model]

## The target

Raise the share of lung cancer patients treated to cure from 22.3% to 24.2% by 2028: 0.6 more patients a year (range 0.0–1.0), for €27,200 a year, about €48,571 per extra patient. [^care_curative][^model] That closes 40% of the measured shortfall against Finland as a whole (1.4 patients a year). [^model]

## Funded actions

| # | Action and owner | Cost a year | More patients treated to cure a year (range) | First step this week | Measure: today → target |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| | **The county can start on Monday** | | | | |
| 1 | **Precise radiotherapy (SBRT) for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated**[^ev_sbrt_pathway_1]. Chief physician of oncology; chief of radiotherapy at the university hospital | €7,920 | 0.3 (0.0–0.5) | Write the referral rule: every stage I patient not accepted for surgery is referred for stereotactic radiotherapy the same week. | Share of patients who get treatment that aims to cure: 22.3% → 23.1% by 2028 |
| 2 | **Travel and hotel paid for patients far from the university hospital**[^ev_travel_accommodation_support_1]. Chief physician of oncology and hospital social work; university hospital patient hotel | €9,880 | 0.2 (0.0–0.4) | Name one contact person who books the patient hotel and transport for every patient sent to the university hospital for curative treatment. | Share of patients who get treatment that aims to cure: 22.3% → 23.1% by 2028 |
| 3 | **Fitness test and training before anyone is ruled too frail for curative treatment**[^ev_prehab_fitness_assessment_1]. Chief physician of pulmonology; leads of rehabilitation and geriatrics | €9,400 | 0.1 (0.0–0.1) | Decide that no stage I-III patient is recorded as "not fit" without an exercise test, and book the physiotherapy group. | Share of patients who get treatment that aims to cure: 22.3% → 22.6% by 2028 |
| | **Total** | **€27,200** | **0.6 (0.0–1.0)** | | |

No trial has measured these effects; the low end of every range is zero. The ranges do not add up to the range of the total, because the measures share one ceiling. Costs are assumptions. [^model]

## Needs a national decision (outside this budget)

- **Low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers**[^ev_ldct_screening_1]: Ministry of Social Affairs and Health and Palko (decision), Finnish Cancer Registry (steering), county (delivery). €222,494 a year; modelled to avoid 0.4 deaths a year (0.1–0.9). Not counted in this budget. Not a county decision. Ask the Ministry and Palko for the timetable after the 2026-2028 pilot and offer the county as a pilot site. [^model]

## What to measure from Monday

- Share of patients treated to cure: 22.3% (2019–2023, measured) → 24.2% by 2028. [^care_curative][^model]
- The registry's public figures cover 2019–2023; count these each month from the county's own records. [^care_curative]

## What more money buys, and what it cannot

In the model, the remaining €972,800 buys nothing more. The measures that add to treatment to cure are limited by the reachable part of the shortfall, not by money. [^model] More could come from a national decision on low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers, or from ranking measures by deaths avoided instead. [^model] Of 24.4 lung cancer deaths a year here, this plan is modelled to avoid 0.1 (range 0.0–0.29). [^deaths][^model]

## Limits

- Ranges are not probabilities. They run from every assumption at its lowest to every assumption at its highest, and no trial has measured these effects. [^model]
- Shares are adjusted only for residents' age, not for stage at diagnosis, other illness, smoking or recording completeness. County figures cannot show cause. [^model]
- A check found that 0 of 3 measured outcomes matched the estimated symptom-to-treatment clock beyond chance. [^model]
